speaker: interviewer
message: QUESTION: Could you please provide an overview of the new product, including its purpose and primary objectives?
subject: Product Overview

speaker: user
message: The new product is a customer relationship management (CRM) tool designed to help small businesses manage customer interactions and data. Its primary objectives are to streamline customer communication, enable better data tracking, and improve overall customer satisfaction.
subject: Product Overview

speaker: interviewer
message: QUESTION: What differentiates this CRM tool from existing solutions in the market?
subject: Product Overview

speaker: user
message: This CRM tool is specifically tailored for small businesses, focusing on ease of use, affordability, and providing key integrations with other commonly used tools like accounting software and email marketing platforms.
subject: Product Overview

speaker: interviewer
message: QUESTION: What key performance indicators (KPIs) or metrics will you use to measure the success of this product?
subject: KPI & Success Metrics

speaker: user
message: We will measure success through metrics such as user adoption rate, customer retention, average time to close a sale, and customer satisfaction scores.
subject: KPI & Success Metrics

speaker: interviewer
message: QUESTION: Are there any specific benchmarks or goals associated with these KPIs, such as desired percentages or timeframes?
subject: KPI & Success Metrics

speaker: user
message: Yes, we are aiming for at least a 60% user adoption rate within the first year, a 10% improvement in customer retention, and a 20% reduction in the average time to close a sale.
subject: KPI & Success Metrics

speaker: interviewer
message: QUESTION: What features or functionality should absolutely be included within the scope of this product?
subject: Scope In and Out

speaker: user
message: The scope should include contact management, sales tracking, email integration, and reporting features as core functionalities.
subject: Scope In and Out

speaker: interviewer
message: QUESTION: Are there any functionalities explicitly out of scope for this product?
subject: Scope In and Out

speaker: user
message: Advanced analytics, AI-driven recommendations, and in-depth financial tools are out of scope for this version of the product.
subject: Scope In and Out

speaker: interviewer
message: QUESTION: Are there specific performance, security, compliance, or availability requirements for the product?
subject: Non-Functional Requirements

speaker: user
message: Yes, the product should handle up to 10,000 customer records efficiently, ensure data is encrypted in transit and at rest, comply with GDPR, and maintain 99.9% uptime.
subject: Non-Functional Requirements
